g.text: MarieRank4Convo5 begins.
Evaluate expressions
Drifter ! I have been scheming.
LoidFamilyComplete
Drifter ! I have been scheming, thinking over what you said of the family above us. And how they might see us as interlopers.
MarieFamilyOther
Drifter ! I have been thinking over what you said of the family above us. My heart breaks for them...
MarieFamily2
MarieFamily1
Why is it we cannot go upstairs ? Why can we not speak to those who called le Cardinal famille ?
false
Should I be scared?
[End.]
As the "other family" in compétition, oui ? This troubles me so.
Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank
Well... in short, some of Entrati's family is upstairs, and they aren't... exactly aware that we're down here.
[End.]
Oui ! The little flying robots. The necra... necra... What do you call them ?
Chat ends.
We do not compete for the love of le Cardinal, how can we help them see this ?
true
How goes your work mending their inner strife ?
false
Update boolean MarieFamily1
Chat ends.
Necramites?
You're right. You can't compete for something a person doesn't have to give.
Opening scabbed-over wounds is dangerous. You might get rid of an infection... or you might bleed out in the process.
You - we - all have one thing in common. At some point, we were left behind by Entrati.
Honestly? I got distracted.
It could be going better.
I'm making progress.
[End.]
Par les Luminaires... You mean that we are all down here in secret ?! Is that why we are not allowed to leave this place ?! Mais pourquoi ?!
Oui ! Ha ! They are so persistent in replacing furniture, non ? But I find if you move things... they do the same thing.
Evaluate expressions
Evaluate expressions
Evaluate expressions
And what could you possibly be distracted by ? What could be more important than sitting down and sorting through the complaints of mécontents ?
What could be difficult about sitting down and sorting through the complaints of mécontents ?
Oh, magnifique !
Chat ends.
His daughter, Euleria - known as Mother, and her family, have been taking care of Deimos this whole time.
What is to stop us from simply moving all the furniture, letting them replace it all, and then... doing it again ? We could sell it all Make profit de ce mobilier étrange !
I am well aware of our unsettled disagreements regarding le Cardinal. I am attempting to keep this conversation civilisée.
MarieEntrati3a
MarieEntrati3b
MarieEntrati3
I understand how you may not wish to discuss mending rifts without finding opportunities to point at those you feel are to blame.
MarieEntratiFamily
false
Oui ! As you are so often wont to remind me, you believe him to be un monstre ! With nothing but spite and emptiness in his heart !
MarieEntratiMonster1
MarieEntratiMonster2
I thought you were on my side in this war for le Cardinal's soul ?
MarieEntratiFan1
MarieEntratiFan2
I thought you had not made up your mind about le Cardinal ? Or has this now changed ?
MarieEntratiNeutral
Oui. This, I am learning with M'sieur Tagfer...
MarieEntrati3a
MarieEntrati3b
Do not speak to me of scabbed wounds, wolf. I am still licking my own from our last discussion of le Cardinal.
MarieEntrati3
Oui, but you said it before - we must all stop blaming each other for these wounds we suffer.
MarieEntratiFamily
I know you believe le Cardinal is some kind of horrible monstre for causing such wounds.
MarieEntratiMonster1
MarieEntratiMonster2
I know you are on my side of this war for le Cardinal's soul, for which I shall be forever grateful.
MarieEntratiFan1
MarieEntratiFan2
I know you are withholding judgement on him, for which I am immensely grateful.
MarieEntratiNeutral
And while I know the others are quick to blame him, I do not wish to see us divided and bleeding when we could be whole.
false
Oui, though I am learning - as with M'sieur Tagfer, that perhaps not all to the same degree.
MarieEntrati3a
MarieEntrati3b
And I am learning that it is not all to the same degree, as you were so "kind" to point out to me, non ?
MarieEntrati3
Oui, yes ! While I do not blame le Cardinal for leaving, for his work is sacro-saint -
MarieEntratiFamily
And I know you believe le Cardinal is some kind of horrible monstre for causing such wounds.
MarieEntratiMonster1
MarieEntratiMonster2
I know you are on my side of this war for le Cardinal's soul, for which I shall be forever grateful.
MarieEntratiFan1
MarieEntratiFan2
I know you are withholding judgement on him, for which I am immensely grateful.
MarieEntratiNeutral
And while the others are quick to blame him for their pain, I simply do not wish to see us divided and suffering.
false
I tease, I tease ! I cannot fathom how busy you are, and all the places - and times - you are needed.
I tease, I tease ! I cannot fathom what they have endured. And how challenging it is for you to untangle it.
I simply worry that without their issues mended, we could never hope to be welcome at their table. The greater problem remains unsolved -
Watching over this place, and the heart that pumps Void energy into the Origin System, keeping all of us... usable, really, ever since Entrati left.
I don't know as there's much of a market for Entrati's chairs...
Wouldn't we flood the market eventually? We'd have to sell them for pretty cheap...
Brilliant. I see no problems with this.
And while I understand the two topics are inexorably linked, I would ask you to keep it productive this day, oui ?
What is this deception of yours, wolf ? Or is little Marie only un jeu to you ?
I haven't made up my mind about the necessity of his actions. But his callous nature can't be questioned.
I'm tired of pretending, I'm sorry.
We must all stop blaming each other for these wounds we suffer.
I do not agree with blaming le Cardinal either, mind, but I do not wish to see us divided and bleeding when we could be whole.
We must all stop blaming each other for these wounds we suffer, regardless of who is ultimately at fault.
Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank
Pff ! I still think this is a worthy experiment. Perhaps we can wall off the devil in a sea of bookcases !
I am going to dutifully ignore your sarcasm, because I think this is a worthy experiment. Perhaps we can wall off the devil in a sea of bookcases !
I seek to aid us all in this... strange coexistence we have found ourselves, not to argue.
No, not a game. But Entrati isn't to be trusted, and I don't know how else to convince you but to pretend to be on your side.
Oui ? Well, I am pleased to tell you, needn't do so any longer.
Together, all as one, we are... a strange family. But a family, none the less.
We would be stronger together than we are apart.
She's come to terms with his absence, and they've made peace with each other, but it was a hard-won thing.
true
She hasn't come to terms with his absence, and they're at each other's throats.
false
+20 Chemistry
Oui ? Well, I am pleased to tell you, you have failed.
Update boolean MarieEntratiFan1
Add +1 to Family
And in times when we're suffering, sometimes all we really have is each other. Either the ones we were given, or the ones we found.
I don't know if it would help, or hurt, in the long run. But this... purgatory, isn't right, either.
Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?
Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?
Much to do ! À la revoyure !
Update boolean MarieEntratiFan2
Add +1 to Family
Oui, I agree. But I cannot be the one to bridge the gap between us. I don't know how to do it ! I am a stranger to them upstairs...
I can't imagine how painful that would be for her. For them.
It would destroy what little chance of reconciliation they might have.
Chat ends.
Update boolean MarieNoDate
Loid knew the Entrati family. It should be him. Convincing him, however... is another matter.
Roathe, maybe? He's Orokin, he knew them all.
While I can see the logic behind the decision to protect them from the pain le Cardinal has caused by his necessary departure...
Oui... I see the logic. I would work to mend their family, if you can, then, non ? It seems to be the only hope any of us have to get out of this place.
Chat ends.
+5 Chemistry
Non, not the devil - anyone but the devil. But you are on to something. The natural choice is Monsieur Loid, non ?
I do think it needlessly cruel, don't you ? They might think him dead. Or worse ! And we, living here, comme des rats d'égout ?
Lest we spend the rest of our lives trapped living here, comme des rats d'égout.
Oui, oui ! C'est ça ! But how do we convince him ? He has been stalwart in his position, non ?
But how do we convince him ? He has been stalwart in his position, non ?
I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.
It's not really my decision to make.
What would you suggest I do?
I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.
I've been remiss. You're right. I'll get to work.
Do you think you or Lyon might convince him?
You're not going to like my answer, Marie...
And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.
I know. It is Monsieur Loid's, and everyone else's decision, to make themselves known.
I would suggest that it is a sense of guilt, not nobility, that keeps us down here.
And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.
Thank you. I do not know if you will succeed, but sometimes, we can only help but to try.
He likes us well enough, he is kind and he is gentle. But we are étrangers to him, newcomers.
Ah bon ?
That we hide some great and terrible sin.
I will think on it. You do the same ! A solution will be found, Sol has guided us this far !
Loid might listen to Roathe. Him being Orokin - their shared history - might come in handy, here.
And it is that sin that must be forgiven, or proven to be false, perhaps ?
+15 Chemistry
Non ! He is a liar, he is a manipulator, he would only do this in exchange for some great fee !
The situation upstairs is... fragile on the best of days. I don't want to upset them.
We just have to be careful. I'm afraid one half will see the other half as "the other family."
We will find a way to convince Monsieur Loid to walk up those stairs... I know it.
We will find another way to convince Monsieur Loid to walk up those stairs... I know it.
You would be surprised how resilient the soul is. And those that surround me now are so very old, so very tempered by time.
Add +1 to Family
I must go. Much to think on, much to do. À la revoyure.
I must go. Much to think on, much to do. À la revoyure.
You have surprised them many times. Let them surprise you this once.
Oh Sol, I think you may have solved it !
Update boolean MarieFamily3b
+15 Chemistry
But what is the direction we take, oui ? We must find a means to convince them.
Update boolean MarieFamilyOther
Chat ends.
Update boolean MarieFamily3a
I am beside myself with excitement - je suis assise ici, remuant sur ma chaise !
Chat ends.
